verdict.rationale: LM Studio's headless 'Local LLM Service' explicitly lists embedding among the capabilities it serves to apps via llama.cpp or MLX [lm-studio-docs-29]. It exposes local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network [lm-studio-docs-5, lm-studio-docs-9], and loads models on demand when a request arrives [lm-studio-docs-30]. Built-in document RAG [lm-studio-docs-7, lm-studio-docs-23] and a community mention of RAG plugins [lm-studio-comm-4] support the retrieval use case. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the embeddings endpoint and its request format, a list of supported embedding models, and hands-on or independent confirmation of serving embeddings for search apps.
